## What
Pre-registered (R1, two sealed specs), seeded (20261001), measured fly-stack v0 on chiaroscuro: fruitfly-ring CX attractor + JevGateV2 ternary cue gating + KC sparse-expansion layer + Moth fnv1a-64 chained notary over the receipts.

## Verdicts (all receipted, failure history rides the receipts)
- **4.1 flycx — PASS 4/4** (`tools/fly_cx.py`, receipt `tools/fly_cx_receipt.json`): v0/v1 FAIL-first sealed, v2 = certainty-gated capture (A0=0.5, commit_gain 0.15). T2 final err 0.007°, T3 amp_drop 0.30, null 71.999°>60, ψ 16C/5R/0A.
- **4.3 CAST v1+v2 — sealed FAIL both** (receipts `tools/cast_eval_receipt.json`, `tools/cast_eval_v2_receipt.json`): delta 0.0; 4/58 zero-evidence failures (wc05/sf10/hr08 unrecoverable). Finding: **synonym-graph vocabulary coverage is the binding constraint, not search policy** (v1 autopsy `tools/cast_diag.js`).
- **4.2 KC layer — sealed FAIL** (`tools/kc_layer_receipt.json`): 5-fold 0.26 < dense null 0.40. Random-expansion KC preserves term-level but not class-level locality in discrete synonym space; needs geometric PN encoding (new pre-registration, not iterated per R8).
- **4.4 Moth notary — ran** (`tools/moth_notary_receipt.json`): 4 cells, proof_head 014e7d51305290c9, quilt_execution AVAILABLE.

## Honesty
- Specs committed before any measured run (`docs/pre-registration-fly-v0.md`, `docs/pre-registration-fly-v0-castv2.md`).
- Degraded suite dumped canonically: `tools/cast_suite.json` (58 prompts).
- No goalpost moves; R8 kill honored.
